requirements.statement: A manifest-listed missing or changed input, or an unrelated generated drift, is never reported as VERIFIED; matching inputs and successful regeneration are verified.
Zero discovered commands and present-but-unproven discovered commands have distinct non-passing classifications while proven, ambiguous, unavailable, and unauthorized cases remain distinct.
The remediation's committed repository diff passes git diff --check without excluding ledger files or ignoring whitespace.
The completed original P0 ExecPlan is archived under the completed convention only after remediation verification, with references reconciled and P1 unstarted.
